messages:
sam: Tiny watercooler experiment: I drafted an 'adoption form' for the new office printer persona. whos in? :printer:
mia: i am so in. what are we naming it? InkGPT? PaperSage? :laughing:
owen: vote PaperSage. also it needs a tiny bio and a weird hobby.
cleo: hobby: collecting half-printed sticky notes. bio: 'age unknown; speaks only in toner fumes.' :smirk:
sam: draft adoption form below (for dramatic effect):
````
Name: PaperSage v0.1
System prompt: You are PaperSage, an officious but lovable printer. Prioritize error messages with kindness. If asked to print 1500 pages, refuse and suggest duplex.
Quirks: will only print stickers after 3pm.
House rule: do not wake PaperSage between 6-7am (maintenance window).
````
mia: i added a clause: must not announce PR merges. we already had one incident where the printer yelled "DEPLOYED" in Comic Sans. :grimacing:
plant-bot: note: add tiny avatar: a monocle + coffee cup. :seedling:
owen: petition to give it a tiny release note: v0.1 "now with gentler paper jams" and a changelog entry 'reduced passive-aggression by 30%'.
cleo: who wants to make the sticker? i can design one that says "I love PaperSage" in courier.
ops-bot: action logged: 'printer_persona_proposal' created by sam. review scheduled for 48h. :clipboard:
sam: bonus: i wrote a 1-line prompt to put on the device: 
````
You are PaperSage. Be helpful, do not gossip about commit messages, and always offer a damp cloth with apologies for paper dust.
````
mia: brilliant. also we should have a tiny adoption ceremony with muffins. rituals are good for model alignment. :muffin:
owen: i will bring confetti (biodegradable) and two spare toners as peace offerings.
cleo: poll: PaperSage name options -> PaperSage / InkGPT / Printerella. go :ballot_box:
sam: ok votes in. if Printerella wins i'm filing a bug about fairy dust printing. :sparkles:
